title: File:Assorted biscuits Khong Guan.JPG
usage: Word problem 1 - Mr Bowen bakes 7128 biscuits and bags them in eights; the test for 8 looks at the last three digits, 128 divided by 8 = 16, so 891 bags exactly. Cropped in from the full frame to the open tin so the biscuits read on a projector. Khong Guan tins are familiar to this class, which is why this one was chosen over a Western cookie plate.

name: chairs.jpg
title: File:Stacked chairs 01.jpg
usage: Word problem 2, the deadpan one - Mr Bowen's 1908 chairs go into rows of 9 with none left over (212 rows). Cropped from the tall original to a landscape band across the three stacks, because a portrait photo has to go in a showcase rather than a split panel.
